paper.title: Dynamic environments do not appear to constrain spider web building behaviour

apparatus.amplitude_convention_note: For affine shear, a 40 degree swing gives 30*tan(20 degrees) = 10.92 cm peak displacement. This supports the approximately 10 cm peak convention; 5 cm remains an apparatus-sensitivity condition. Flexible-frame deformation is not exactly affine.

paper.design: RRMRM repeated builds; five spiders completed the full regime
paper.raw_data_status: Not supplied with this repository. The publication states data are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

measurement_notes.eccentricity: sqrt((1 - web_width / web_height)^2), Table 1; not conic eccentricity
measurement_notes.mean_mesh_space_cm: (north capture width + south capture width) / (north capture count + south capture count - 2)
measurement_notes.capture_spiral_area_cm2: hub plus capture spiral area minus hub area

paper.provenance: Apparatus and sampling: pages 2-3; Table 1: page 3; sample sizes and results: pages 4-6; data availability: page 7. Checked against the supplied PDF.

uncertainty_unit: initial motion phase; not biological individual
